messages:
Kevin Choi: FYI — FluxTier just uploaded their SIG/CAIQ bundle and a long compliance packet. Sales flagged some answers that don't match what they verbally promised (notably around KMS, encryption, and network topology). Dropping the CAIQ snippets I pulled below.

Samir Patel: Which questions are off? paste the QIDs and I'll triage.

Kevin Choi: Here are two that jumped out:
```
CAIQ-ENCRYPTION-03: "Encryption at rest: AES-128"
CAIQ-IDENTITY-01: "SSO enforced for all users"
```
But sales notes say "managed keys (BYOK optional)" and screenshots show local service accounts. So conflicting.

Maria Gonzalez: Do we have a SOC2 report attached? Sales told me it's "in progress" which is a red flag for enterprise deals.

Jess Taylor: POC blocker: they currently only support IP allowlist for connectivity according to the packet. If they don't support VPC peering / private endpoints that's going to put them in PCI-scope for us — can't have that for the payments POC.

Kevin Choi: Correct — sales said "IP allowlist + private subnet option coming Q3". That's vague. @Samir can you mark this as enterprise-blocker if they can't do peering?

Samir Patel: Marking as red for now. Ask list: 1) SOC2 Type II 2023 report or timeline, 2) KMS model (BYOK vs managed vs HSM), key rotation policy and algorithms (AES-128 vs AES-256?), 3) proof SSO enforced (IdP config / SAML metadata), 4) network topology options (VPC peering, PrivateLink, or only IP lists). I'll draft a short checklist we can send.

vendor-intake-bot: New intake ticket created: VR-3281. Please upload requested evidence to the secure intake portal: https://portal.redwood.internal/vendor-evidence/VR-3281. Assigned to Maria Gonzalez.

Maria Gonzalez: I'll ask for KMS architecture diagram and the SOC2 scoping statement. Also requesting the CAIQ export referencing the specific answers for the 3 controls above. ETA: EOD tomorrow to vendor.

Jess Taylor: Thanks. Also include a question about service-account MFA and whether machine-to-machine keys are rotated automatically. Those are common gotchas.

Kevin Choi: Good call. I'll inform sales to pause deeper negotiations until we get a clear answer on peering and SOC2. :eyes:

Samir Patel: Draft checklist (I'll paste to the ticket):
- SOC2 Type II report (PDF) or auditor contact
- KMS description: managed/BYOK/HSM + algorithms + rotation cadence
- Evidence of encryption at rest (config screenshots, metadata)
- IdP/SAML config proof (SSO enforced for all user types)
- Network options: VPC peering, PrivateLink, VPC endpoints, IP allowlist details
- Service account MFA / machine key rotation details
- Any vulnerability scan/pen test reports in last 12 months

Maria Gonzalez: Perfect. I'll attach that and ping them. Will update VR-3281 when they reply. :thumbsup:

vendor-intake-bot: Reminder: please attach evidence to VR-3281 within 72 hours to avoid escalation.
